title: Deadcalm
summary: Deadcalm is one of Klaus's creations, made from pieces of a tablet inscribed with the power Breakspell. It has the power to burrow into its target and completely drain them of the ability to use magic.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Whilst working as a [[Suit]] in the [[Organization]], [[Zhalia Moon]] used Deadcalm against [[Montehue]]. {{Source|TCG:OAL-080|OAL-080}}

[[Klaus]] planned to have [[Zhalia Moon]] use it against [[Dante Vale]] and then dispose of him; however she had a change of heart and used it on the enchanted door in [[Newgrange Passage Tomb]] so that she, [[Sophie Casterwill]], Dante, and [[Scarlet Byrne]] could help [[Lok Lambert]]. {{source|Home Turf}}

full_text:
Deadcalm is one of Klaus's creations, made from pieces of a tablet inscribed with the power Breakspell. It has the power to burrow into its target and completely drain them of the ability to use magic.

History

Whilst working as a Suit in the Organization, Zhalia Moon used Deadcalm against Montehue. [OAL-080]

Klaus planned to have Zhalia Moon use it against Dante Vale and then dispose of him; however she had a change of heart and used it on the enchanted door in Newgrange Passage Tomb so that she, Sophie Casterwill, Dante, and Scarlet Byrne could help Lok Lambert. [Home Turf]

Abilities

Deadcalm has the ability to burrow into its target and completely drain them of the ability to use magic. This item also has the ability to drain the magic energy of objets like shown with the door Ireland. [Home Turf]

International Names

French: Calme-mort
Portuguese: Morte-calma
